sections.subtitle: MARKETPLACE ORDER MANAGEMENT
sections.title:
More marketplaces.
One clearer view.
sections.content: Bring marketplace orders, item details and delivery updates into one workspace—so your team can focus on what needs attention.

imageSlots.mediaAlt: Illustrative marketplace order workspace with Shopee and Lazada source tiles, example order rows and an order details card. No customer data.

sections.title: Bring your stores into the same conversation.
sections.content: Spend less time moving between store accounts. Review marketplace orders together, with the store behind every order kept clear.

imageSlots.mediaAlt: Illustrative Shopee and Lazada store tiles connected to one order view. Fictional stores and sample orders.

sections.title: Find the orders that need you.
sections.content: Narrow the view by store, marketplace or order status—so your team can find what needs attention without searching every account.

imageSlots.mediaAlt: Illustrative marketplace filters highlight in sequence while sample orders appear and light flows towards the filtered view.

sections.title: See the details behind the sale.
sections.content: Keep purchased items, quantities, SKU references and delivery information close at hand—so your team can review an order with a clearer understanding of what was sold.

imageSlots.mediaAlt: Illustrative order details with product highlights, quantities, SKU reference card and delivery context appearing in sequence. Fictional order data.

sections.title: Match every order to the right product.
sections.content: Keep marketplace SKU references connected to your catalogue—so your team can clearly identify what was sold, even when each store uses a different code.

imageSlots.mediaAlt: Illustrative Shopee and Lazada SKU references linked to one internal catalogue product. Light flows towards the internal MUG-CRM reference.

sections.title: Stay clear on what needs another look.
sections.content: Keep order updates and tracking information in view, and revisit missing records—so your team knows where to look next.

items.title: Keep the order in view.
items.description: Review updated order details before your team follows up.

items.title: Keep delivery context close.
items.description: See courier and tracking references alongside the order.

items.title: Revisit the missing pieces.
items.description: Recheck a selected period for orders that did not appear.

sections.title: Add a clearer way to manage your stores.
sections.subtitle: A few helpful answers.

items.title: Is Marketplace a standalone plan?
items.description: Marketplace is an optional add-on to your selected plan. The fee is charged per store, per month.

items.title: Can I view orders from more than one store?
items.description: Yes. Review orders from connected stores together, with each order retaining its store and marketplace reference.

items.title: What order information can my team review?
items.description: Review purchased items, quantities, SKU references, order status and available courier and tracking information.

items.title: What if an order is missing or delayed?
items.description: Review order updates and tracking references, or recheck a selected date range for missing orders. Availability depends on the connected platform and its updates.

sections.title: Make your next order easier to manage.
sections.content: Tell us where you sell and how your team handles orders. We’ll help you shape a setup around your stores and working routine.

imageSlots.mediaAlt: Illustrative shared order workspace linking Store A and Store B with a confirmation badge.
